module-ownership.text: As a contributor, I want one owner for each shared concern, while a caller of the established modules keeps its import path and result.

responsibilities.text: Owners may split further only when the resulting dependency graph remains acyclic and the responsibility remains evident. The 150–350 line guide is a review aid; a module over 500 lines needs an explanation, not automatic failure.

The documentation build consumes the Cabal library declaration and candidate source, then supplies a rendered API tree to the site and its link checker. The resulting references are documentation artifacts; they do not change the library's public Haskell exports.
